text: Done in template v34 (a978089) and builds 0003 (80d9ee0). (1) dftmd-12: src/validate_tasks.py reports a held item, held {reason, needs}, not_run with 'held: <reason>; it needs <needs>', makes no call and looks for no reference function; the builder refuses a held item without its reason or needs, expected otherwise, naming a reference function, calling a tool the bundle lacks, or under a template before v34; qe-h2-bond/0003's and hoomd-h2-bond/0003's sci-1 are held items, and B5 prints both PENDING. (2) dftmd-10: where a task's reference.unit is not its measure.unit, every value a call measures, the finer runs' too, is converted into reference.unit by unit_convert@v1 from the registry the bundle carries before the rule and the agreement run, so the run's own error, a rule tolerance (the builder takes it in reference.unit) and the agreement are in it; the result carries measured_converted and the builder's validation report writes measured {value, unit, converted_from, converted_by}, which check 12 passes in meta_agent/tests/test_template_v34.py on a DFT rest length against angstrom and a viscosity against mPa.s; the builder refuses a task with a printed unit and no measure.unit, or units of two dimensions. The same version names, in a hand-over's definition, the tool field each input came from (dftmd-16). meta_agent/tests 484 OK, contracts/tests 177 OK; v34 watched failing with v33's tree in its place (4 of 9 tests; the other 5 are the builder's refusals).
